payload.tension: The passage states love and light expose hidden works. Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children. Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
